meaning: Horn 1 of the peritropē (Theaetetus 171a-c, unqualified reading). Composes the pilot's conflicting-opinions test (PILOT-CONFLICTING-OPINIONS-TEST) with the conflict located in the thesis itself: Protagoras asserts it and (open, unattributed) sincerely holds it, someone denies it, the doctrine's scope covers both, and unindexed truth respects negation; so not every opinion in scope is true. The negation bridge is the pilot's open premise; no refutes relation is recorded.
